snippet.title: SONIC PICO PARK - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Super Sonic joins the party! The time has come to grab your friends and work together to navigate puzzles and challenges together.

SONIC PICO PARK is out now on PC and consoles with cross-platform compatibility!

🎮 https://picoparkgame.com/en/spp/
